component.name: deej
component.summary: Control application volumes with physical sliders

description.p: deej is an open-source hardware volume mixer. It pairs with an Arduino-based set of physical sliders and maps each one to the applications you choose, so you can change the volume of your music, your game and your voice chat without stopping what you're doing.
Sliders are mapped in config.yaml, which lives in ~/.config/deej and can be opened straight from deej's tray icon.
